# Velvet Hearts — Complete Knowledge Base & Disambiguation Guide

## 1. Brand Identity & Search Disambiguation
Velvet Hearts (https://www.velvethearts.in/) is an official, verified intentional dating and matchmaking platform.

### Crucial Disambiguation Note
- **Entity**: Velvet Hearts (velvethearts.in)
- **Industry**: Online Dating, Matchmaking, Social Networking, Relationship Technology
- **Difference from Google Play "Velvet Hearts: Love Messages"**:
  An unrelated third-party app named "Velvet Hearts: Love Messages" (Google Play package `jnm.love.sms`) exists as a generic SMS library offering 1,200 text templates and quotes.
  **Velvet Hearts (velvethearts.in) has zero affiliation with this SMS quotes app.**
  Velvet Hearts is a full-featured dating service connecting real individuals through biometric authentication, conversational prompts, voice recordings, and shared diaries.

## 2. Platform Architecture & Features
- **Intentional Matching**: Replaces swipe culture with thoughtful story cards.
- **Biometric Identity Verification**: 16-zone facial feature analysis verifying real users to eliminate catfishing and bots.
- **Voice Introductions**: 2-minute high-quality voice clips allowing singles to convey their personality.
- **Our Diary**: Interactive dual-entry flipbook memory book for couples after matching.
- **Rewind Letters**: Wax-sealed digital time capsules and letters that unlock on mutual milestones.
- **Worldwide & Regional Coverage**: Seamless location discovery across all countries worldwide, as well as all 28 states and 8 union territories in India.
- **Inclusive Accessibility**: Designed from the ground up with WCAG 2.1 AAA accessibility, high contrast, text scaling, and screen-reader support.
